message: 眠れない夜

name: Synn
message: 「Fuwaah... morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin'~」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「What a fool.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right out of the blue first thing in the morning!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you know~, the truth is the truth whether it's morning or night~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that actually sounds kind of profound!」

name: Azel
message: 「You cried.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah~, Synn-kun, your eyes look just like a rabbit's~」

name: Azel
message: 「You were betrayed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By who?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Isn't that obvious~? Synn-kun was betrayed by Nana-chan~. A new spring of romance has arrived for Nana-chan~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Finally! Don't go thinking you were betrayed, though. It's your own fault for being such a clueless blockhead, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, both of you.」

name: Azel
message: 「I trust it has sunk into your very bones how foolish it is to forgive a Demon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... could you be talking about Ringer?」

name: Azel
message: 「Who is that.」

name: Synn
message: 「The musician from yesterday.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh!? The guy who brought the delivery was a musician~? He didn't look human to me, though~」

name: Eddie
message: 「So Yuugiri's new partner is a musician, huh.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「At least pick a human--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, both of you.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no way a lazy, brutish, and barbaric Demon would ever keep a promise. Let this be a lesson, and show their kind no mercy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for worrying about me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I was not worrying about you or anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That guy actually worked hard the whole time we were open, you know.」
In the end, as compensation for the disposable chopsticks he broke and the nearly one hour of lost business, we decided to have him work for a few days.

name: Nanaka
message: 「He looked super happy that he got paid for working.」

name: Synn
message: 「He said he's gonna save up money to buy a theremin.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why a theremin!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe they don't have them in the Demon World?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Theremiiin?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the world's first invented electronic musical instrument. A mysterious instrument you play without touching it with your hands.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I seeee.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh. Actually, there was one thing about him that pissed me off!」

name: Azel
message: 「Just as I thought. A Demon, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I served him some soba after our shift, right? And the guy had the nerve to say my old man's handmade noodles tasted better than mine!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's true, though. Damn it. One day I'm gonna make him eat his words!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, actually, there is one problem.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph. A Demon, after all. Did he cause trouble.」

name: Synn
message: 「Turns out he really is a musician, and he sings all night long. Because of that, I'm totally sleep-deprived... *yaaaawn*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the landlord, so you gotta put your foot down and tell him off!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, apparently it's the equivalent of death metal in this world, so it being noisy can't really be helped.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If it's death metal, can't be helped--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You think so? Wait, do you even know what Deathmetal is?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I at least know you can't eat it~」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell me... you're letting him stay at your place!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unbelievable.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. My place is cramped. Plus those three are crashed out at the shop.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it, I've got plenty of spare rooms and it's only for a few days.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's new lover and Synn-kun under one roof~ I smell drama~」

name: Eddie
message: 「If they interview me as a friend, I'll say, 'I always knew Synn would get wrapped up in a case like this someday'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, you guys!」
